### 1. Full Navigation Menu  
The navigation bar is a **dark gray (near-black)** horizontal bar spanning the top of the page, positioned below the "TOSTEM" logo (left-aligned, bold, uppercase, dark gray) and the tagline "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" (right-aligned, smaller, dark gray). The menu items are evenly spaced, left-aligned, and use a clean, sans-serif font. Each item has a downward-facing chevron (▼) indicating a dropdown menu.  

- **ABOUT TOSTEM** (leftmost)  
- **WHY TOSTEM**  
- **OUR PRODUCTS** (partially visible, likely includes sub-items like "Windows," "Doors," "Hardware")  
- **OUR SERVICES** (partially visible)  
- **CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**  
- **REACH US** (rightmost)  


### 2. Hero Section Content  
The hero section occupies the majority of the visible page, featuring a **large, high-resolution image** of a modern interior with floor-to-ceiling windows (showcasing sleek, minimalist design). The image has a subtle overlay of the text "Panoramic Corner Sliding Doors" in a light gray, elegant serif font, centered horizontally and vertically.  

- **Left Side**: A vertical black button with white text: "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE" (uppercase, sans-serif, bold).  
- **Right Side**: A vertical black button with white text: "ENQUIRE NOW" (uppercase, sans-serif, bold).  
- **Top Right Corner**: A circular blue button with a white phone icon (likely a "Call Us" CTA).  


### 3. All Sections Visible on the Page  
Only the **hero section** is fully visible, with the navigation bar above it. A modal popup ("BOOK AN APPOINTMENT") overlays the hero section, and a cookie consent bar is at the bottom.  


### 4. Color Scheme  
- **Primary**: Dark gray (navigation bar, logo, text) and white (background, modal, buttons).  
- **Accent**: Black (CTA buttons, modal border).  
- **Secondary**: Light gray (hero text overlay, modal text).  
- **Brand**: Blue (phone icon button).  


### 5. Buttons/CTAs  
- **Modal Popup ("BOOK AN APPOINTMENT")**:  
  - White input fields with light gray placeholder text (e.g., "Enter your name," "Enter your email address").  
  - Black dropdown menus (e.g., "Select State," "Are you a").  
  - Black "SUBMIT" button with white uppercase text (centered, bold).  
- **Hero Section**:  
  - "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE" (black background, white text, vertical, left-aligned).  
  - "ENQUIRE NOW" (black background, white text, vertical, right-aligned).  
  - Phone icon button (blue background, white icon, circular, top-right).  
- **Cookie Bar**:  
  - "Cookie settings" (gray text, underline, right-aligned).  
  - "ACCEPT" (black background, white text, uppercase, right-aligned).  


### 6. Footer Structure (Partially Visible)  
Not fully visible, but a **cookie consent bar** is at the bottom of the page:  
- Left-aligned text: "We use cookies on our website to give you the most relevant experience by remembering your preferences and repeat visits. By clicking 'Accept', you consent to the use of ALL the cookies." (small, gray, sans-serif).  
- Right-aligned buttons: "Cookie settings" (gray, underlined) and "ACCEPT" (black, white text, uppercase).  


### Modal Popup Details (Overlays Hero Section)  
- **Header**: "BOOK AN APPOINTMENT" (centered, dark gray, uppercase, bold, sans-serif).  
- **Close Button**: "×" (top-right, black, bold, large font).  
- **Form Fields**:  
  1. "Enter your name" (full-width, white, light gray placeholder).  
  2. Two columns: "Enter your email address" (left) and "Enter your mobile number" (right).  
  3. Two columns: "City" (left, text input) and "Select State" (right, dropdown).  
  4. Two columns: "Are you a" (left, dropdown) and "You are looking for" (right, dropdown).  
- **Submit Button**: "SUBMIT" (full-width, black, white text, uppercase, bold, sans-serif).  


### Layout & Visual Design  
- **Grid**: The page uses a clean, responsive grid with the navigation bar fixed at the top, hero section as the main content, and modal/popup centered.  
- **Typography**: Sans-serif for navigation/CTAs, serif for hero text (elegant contrast).  
- **Whitespace**: Ample spacing between elements for a minimalist, modern feel.  
- **Modal**: Semi-transparent dark gray background (to dim the hero section) with a white, rounded-corner popup (centered, 600px wide, 400px tall).  

This design emphasizes simplicity, functionality, and a focus on window design innovation, with clear CTAs to drive user engagement.
